title: Sales Engineer
description:
The Sales Engineer connects with the company technical pre-sales with its commercial motion. Working alongside the Solutions Architect, who owns the technical pre-sales and pilot delivery, the Sales Engineer helps frame opportunities, shape the sales position, prepare the materials that move a deal forward, and helps run the sales process day to day, in support of the Chief Executive Officer's selling.

This is a hands-on, supporting role for someone with a technical foundation and commercial curiosity who wants to build a career in technical sales. It carries enough technical depth to support demonstrations and translate customer requirements, and enough commercial involvement to help qualify, position and progress opportunities. It is a development path towards a Solutions Architect or a broader commercial role over time.

Our company sells its cloud product today. Sovereign and air-gapped deployment for secure infrastructure environments is in development as a coming capability, and the role should be able to speak to where the product is heading.

Key activities

Pre-sales support.
Support the Solutions Architect in preparing and running demonstrations, including setting up environments and tailoring each demonstration to the customer's requirements.

Opportunity framing.
Help translate a customer's needs into a clear opportunity, mapping their problem to the company workflow and articulating the value.

Sales materials.
Prepare proposals, scoping documents, follow-up notes and the collateral that moves a deal from conversation to pilot.

Qualification support.
Gather and organise the information needed to qualify an opportunity.

Sales process operation.
Keep the CRM current, track opportunities, schedule follow-ups, and keep deals moving through the pipeline.

Customer liaison.
Be a responsive point of contact for prospects through the sales process, coordinating between the customer, the Solutions Architect and the rest of the team.

Accountabilities and responsibilities

Pre-sales readiness.
Responsible for demonstrations and pre-sales materials being prepared, accurate and ready on time.

Opportunity quality.
Responsible for opportunities being well framed and well documented as they move through the sales process.

Pipeline hygiene.
Responsible for accurate, current CRM and pipeline records.

Coordination.
Responsible for smooth coordination between the technical and commercial activity on each deal.

Commercial support.
Supports the Chief Executive Officer on commercial terms, negotiation and closing.

Skills, background and experience

Capability is assessed on demonstrated outcomes, not years served.

Qualifications

Degree in an engineering, technical or commercial discipline, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

Background

Some exposure to technical sales, pre-sales, applications engineering or another technical customer-facing role, or a technical background with a clear interest in moving into technical sales.

Familiarity with hardware, FPGA, semiconductor or EDA concepts, or the ability to get up to speed quickly.

Capabilities

Enough technical understanding to support demonstrations and talk credibly with engineers.

Well organised, with strong attention to detail across materials and CRM.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Proactive and responsive: keeps deals and follow-ups moving.

Keen to learn and grow in a technical-sales career.

title: Content Marketing Specialist
description:
We're looking for a Product Marketing (Content) Manager who enjoys taking ownership, thinks strategically, and is passionate about creating content that drives business impact. This role goes beyond writing-you'll own content initiatives from planning through execution, translating product capabilities into compelling stories that educate the market, strengthen our brand, and support business growth.

We value people who are proactive, curious, and comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. If you enjoy solving problems, taking initiative, and continuously improving your craft, we'd love to meet you.

Responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end content marketing process, from planning and ideation to execution, publishing, and performance analysis.

Develop and execute content strategies that support product launches, brand awareness, customer education, lead generation, and customer retention.

Create high-quality content across multiple channels, including blogs, LinkedIn, newsletters, case studies, website content, and product marketing assets.

Proactively identify content opportunities by working closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and other stakeholders.

Conduct market, customer, and competitor research to develop relevant messaging, positioning, and content angles.

Translate complex product capabilities into clear, engaging, and customer-focused content.

Monitor content performance using analytics and continuously optimize content based on insights and business objectives.

Manage multiple content projects simultaneously while prioritizing effectively and meeting deadlines.

Stay up to date with industry trends, AI developments, and content marketing best practices to continuously improve our marketing efforts.

Requirements:

2-4 years of experience in content marketing, product marketing, or B2B marketing, preferably in a SaaS, technology, startup, or agency environment.

Exceptional English writing and editing skills, supported by a portfolio of published work (blogs, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, case studies, or similar).

A thoughtful and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently own projects from ideation through execution. Demonstrates curiosity by asking thoughtful questions, exploring multiple approaches, experimenting with ideas, and taking initiative instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

Strong judgment and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing priorities, and consistently deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote working environment.

Familiarity with SEO/GEO principles, content analytics (e.g., Google Analytics), and AI-assisted content workflows.

Proficiency in Canva or similar design tools.

Experience in the B2B SaaS or MICE industry is a plus.

WHY JUBLIA

This is going to be a learning experience like no other! Be prepared to be challenged in a fast-paced environment.

Our global clientele will challenge your thinking about matchmaking in different geographical cultures, across more than 40 different industry sectors.

The products you build will be used by leading B2B events with over 100,000 unique users monthly.

GREAT RANGE OF OUR PERKS

We are mostly remote, where you can work from the comfort of your home, and enjoy flexible working time.

Enjoy annual bonuses and salary increments designed to propel your career growth and success.

Additional end of year paid holiday leave entitlement besides the common yearly paid leave. Spend the rest of the year with your beloved or enjoy the time by yourself.
